notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Business Time
notes.notes:
We don’t really do themes for Unknown Pleasures, but sometimes the fates mess up and it sort of happens anyway. This week features the usual variety you’ve surely come to expect from our selection of the best new indie games on Steam, but fans of commerce ought to be particularly tickled.

There, see? We can do an intro without banging on about what time of year it is, or weird allusions to my private life. We just choose not to.

Owning the means of production this week: art history, baby dragons, and demonic denial. (more…)

notes.title: Critical times are fast approaching in ARTé: Mecenas
notes.notes:
Dear Friends,

Take every opportunity to raise your standing with Florence and the Church, that you may establish yourself as a banker of renown.  For as you know the season in Florence has been difficult for the farmers, and the harvest may not sustain us. Even now, there are people going hungry in the streets. 

Remember that families like the Albizzi and Strozzi seem to oppose the Medici at every turn. Distribute aid of food and blankets to the poor. Stamp them with the emblem of the Medici Bank so that other families cannot tell the people that although they asked you to help, you do not care for the people of Florence.

If you do not have enough success, I fear other families may overtake the Medici.

I have extended my gesture of good will as a gift to you so that our name and works may prosper.

[quote][i]promotional 10% off discount has been extended until November 28th, 2018[/i][/quote]

To your health and success,
[i][b]Cousin Vieri[/b][/i]

notes.title: The war between Milan and Venice requires your wisdom
notes.notes:
Dear Friends,

There is much tumult among your colleagues and I fear that you can no longer sit by without taking action.  Florence demands that you choose a side in this war between Milan and Venice. 

Will you ally with Venice against the rising powers in Milan or will you donate florins to Milan in order to forgive past transgressions with Venice?

Which side will you choose?  The city of Florence awaits your answer in [b]ARTé: Mecenas[/b], available now.

To your health and success,
[i][b]Cousin Vieri[/b][/i]
